decisions.problem: The tour claimed guided use but lacked a one-step-at-a-time field presentation control.
decisions.evidence: v1.7.52 tour structure and owner mission
decisions.expectedBenefit: More reliable short in-office demonstration with less scrolling and clearer pacing.
decisions.reason: Material field-use benefit with complete local implementation and fallback.
decisions.acceptanceTest: Mode, progress, previous/next, direct navigation, keyboard and self-guided regression tests.
decisions.reusableLesson: Separate presenter and self-guided modes when one public narrative must support both guided and independent review.

decisions.problem: A generic copied link is less useful during walk-in attorney outreach.
decisions.evidence: Owner outreach objective and v1.7.52 continuation gap
decisions.expectedBenefit: Immediate scan-and-return path without manual typing or invasive tracking.
decisions.scope: Public static assets, short routes and print card
decisions.risk: Stale production routing or accidental tracking
decisions.dependency: Production domain routing must be verified before printed distribution
decisions.acceptanceTest: Fixed routes, recorded QR digests, no personal/matter/campaign data in QR destinations, print rendering.
decisions.reusableLesson: Use fixed short paths and static QR assets for durable handoffs; keep attribution separate and optional.

decisions.problem: Could make tour destinations look current.
decisions.evidence: No exact staging or monitoring contract exists
decisions.reason: Current labeled fallback is safer and more truthful.
decisions.acceptanceTest: Exact staging and monitored availability contract.
decisions.reusableLesson: Do not trade deterministic demonstrations for unverified network probing.
